page.notes: Right column at top: "a longâ servitute liberatas tunc lætati eas sublimesque ferri." followed by a side reference "pag. 241. Sunt & inter eos qui forma..." which is cut off. The page is cut off at the foot; the last line is incomplete. The header "E X S P I C" is a running title line in spaced capitals, here treated as a heading. The lower part of the first column is partly unclear; the line "Crassus quidam ... existens." is read across the two column halves. Several words in the top paragraph are blurred and may be misread (e.g. "prahiames", "Me."). The "I L E G I O." heading is spaced capitals, possibly a fragment of a longer word.
